interpretation.0000_0008_0016: The methane tail is approximately 10000yr; a 200kyr hold is a motivated extension, not a computed pass.
interpretation.0004: Banks are rapidly slaved to a still-relaxing atmospheric/H2 state; the physical tail is approximately the reference methane lifetime.
interpretation.0052: Warm dormant M drives the 20kyr span. Its transient diminishes, but final 1kyr bulk-bank variation remains near the strict threshold. A longer hold does not guarantee microscopic precision.
interpretation.precision: Fixed pressure and stage absolute tolerances can limit tiny-bank resolution. Tighter rtol alone is not a guaranteed precision control. No criterion is weakened.
interpretation.rates: Instantaneous relative RHS of a small slaved bank is not its relaxation eigenvalue and can differ from sampled drift.

scope: Five original 100kyr census profiles, partial-grid late-stock diagnostic only; no new trajectories or changed statuses
